user.title: Voitas Wallbox
user.description: Enter the IP address of your Voitas Wallbox.

power.title: Charging Power
power.description: Enter a fallback charging power in kW, and optionally link an entity (e.g. your car's charging power sensor). When linked, the entity value is used whenever it reports a valid value; the fallback value is used otherwise (e.g. entity unavailable) and when no entity is linked.

error.cannot_connect: Could not receive data from the Wallbox. Check the IP and make sure it's on the same network.
